lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) were generally helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%), though one test performed worse (-4.6%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 2 tests (+6.1% and +4.7%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.3% and -9.2%).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect) and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.

candidates.title: Story Screen Hero Journey Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story introduction into a grid layout showcasing hero visuals of available companion paths.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s, indicating users pause during early introduction. A grid layout provides clear visual options upfront.

guard.reason: The redesign removes the pet introduction from the story screen, failing its required job.

candidates.title: Account Session Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint on the sign-in screen confirming that signing in protects saved pets from resetting across app restarts.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back into an account.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet memory and traits are safely saved across restarts.

guard.reason: Adds an explanatory persistence hint on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints have strong historical performance (+2.2% avg, 2/3 wins) and both funnel drop and 8 support tickets confirm user confusion.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Stage Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Replaces the default pet selection list with a clear grid view featuring highlight badges for companion traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the early flow at 72.7% with a mean time of 1017s. A structured grid speeds up selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection stage into a grid with trait badges while maintaining its job to let the user pick a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off, but adoption redesigns have performed inconsistently across 4 tests with a slightly negative mean.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated preview screen after photo upload so users can inspect image clarity before final adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output due to photo issues.

new_custom_preview.headline: Preview Your Companion
new_custom_preview.body: Verify your uploaded photo features clear lighting and framing before adoption.

guard.reason: Adds a valid preview screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps intact.

candidates.score_note: Targeted support issues exist, but adding new screens typically introduces significant funnel friction (e.g. -15.2% on finish).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Processing Info
candidates.change: Displays an explanatory status hint reassuring users that pet assets are preparing seamlessly in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about app responsiveness.

waiting.hint: Your desktop pet is being prepared in the background. It will launch on your screen shortly.

guard.reason: Adds status progress info to the waiting screen, maintaining its job of showing the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Long duration at home step indicates hesitation, but wait_info changes showed no clear strong effect across past 2 tests (+1.7% avg).

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the final welcome screen into a split view highlighting fundamental desktop pet interaction tips.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% and support received 3 complaints regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.

components.text: Click or drag your pet anytime on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen layout within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the largest drop-off (32%) and direct support complaints; redesign carries some risk but addresses clear onboarding confusion.

candidates.title: Choose Path Clarity Headline Update
candidates.change: Updates the choose path headline and body text to clearly distinguish between preset library pets and custom creations.
candidates.why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path suggests hesitation between available path choices.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Ideal Companion Experience
choose_path.body: Pick between adoption from our pet library or creating a unique custom pet.

guard.reason: Clarifies copy while continuing to present both adoption and custom pet options.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has low drop-off and copy changes in this category previously showed a negative result (-3.0%).

candidates.title: Certificate Official Adoption Record Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the adoption certificate screen emphasizing that registration creates a permanent digital pet record.
candidates.why: Adoption completion is only 72.7%. Reinforcing ownership value encourages users to complete adoption.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your adoption certificate registers your pet's permanent digital identity.

guard.reason: Adds an explanatory hint to the adoption certificate screen without modifying core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drop-off is high, but adoption hints underperformed in prior testing (-4.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Completion Button Copy
candidates.change: Changes the primary action button label on the final screen to action-oriented text.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 27.0%, with a 32.0% drop at the final completion step.

guard.reason: Updates home intro button label appropriately inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop is severe (32%); low-cost copy change showed minor positive lift (+0.9%) in past test.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Verification Flow
candidates.change: Adds a verification step right before home intro to check that the desktop pet window renders properly.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to open after onboarding.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Confirm Desktop Visibility
new_desktop_verify.body: Ensure your companion window is visible on your primary desktop screen.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid verification screen before home intro while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Solves reported rendering issues, but adding a full new verification flow adds drop-off risk (home new_flow historical: -2.2%).

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, while zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 3 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded mixed results, winning in 2 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%) but performing worse in 2 others (-4.6% and -5.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 3 tests (+6.1%, +4.7%, and +6.2%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.4% and -9.3%).

Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect), choose_path copy (1 win, 1 worse), and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.
